meetings.title: Pricing review
chunks: Okay, let's get through pricing. Last time we had three options on the table for the Pro tier.
I looked at the competitor sheet. Most of them sit between twenty and thirty dollars per seat.
Then let's lock Pro at twenty-five dollars per seat per month. Everyone okay with that?
Enterprise stays custom-quoted, with a minimum of fifty seats.
For annual billing we give two months free.
Tax we will not build ourselves; we hand that to Stripe Tax.
I'll update the pricing page copy by Friday.

meetings.title: Launch planning
chunks: The release candidate build ATLAS-RC3 passed the full regression suite last night.
Good. Do we still target the second of December for the public launch?
Yes, December second holds, unless the SSO bug reopens.
Marketing needs the final screenshots a week before, so by the twenty-fifth.
Ticket PLAT-4412 is the SSO redirect loop; it is fixed on staging.
Then we ship on December second. Decision made.
I'll book the launch webinar for December third.
Rollback plan is the blue-green switch; we keep RC2 warm for forty-eight hours.

meetings.title: Design critique
chunks: The onboarding flow has too many steps; people drop off at step four.
We could merge the workspace and team steps into one screen.
Let's also make the calendar connection optional instead of blocking.
The empty state on the dashboard needs a sample meeting so it does not look broken.
Accessibility review flagged contrast on the secondary buttons.
I'll bump the secondary button contrast to meet AA.

meetings.title: Infra sync
chunks: Postgres CPU spikes every night at two, it is the analytics export job.
Can we move the export to the read replica?
Yes, we move the nightly export to the replica starting this week.
That one was the session cache with no TTL; we set a twenty-four hour TTL.
Okay. Backups are still nightly to R2 with thirty days retention.

meetings.title: Hiring sync
chunks: We have two finalists for the frontend role.
I liked the second candidate's take-home, the state management was clean.
Let's extend the offer to the second candidate, Maya.
Agreed, and we start the onboarding buddy plan with Lee.

meetings.title: Sam and Lee 1:1
chunks: Between us, the Pro price might go to thirty dollars next quarter.
I am thinking about moving to the platform team in January.
Let's keep the acquisition talks with Northwind confidential.
Understood, nobody else hears about Northwind yet.

documents.title: Billing RFC
elements: Invoices are generated on the first of each month and emailed as PDF.
Failed payments are retried three times over ten days before the workspace is downgraded.
Sales tax and VAT are calculated by Stripe Tax; we store only the resulting amounts.

decisions.content: Pro tier priced at 25 dollars per seat per month.
Nightly analytics export moves to the read replica.
Extend the frontend offer to Maya.
Keep the Northwind acquisition talks confidential.
